checks.title: Royal Caribbean Kids Sail Free and free 3rd and 4th guests
checks.headline: Kids 12 and under pay no cruise fare on select 3+ night sailings, but every guest still pays taxes, fees and port expenses, and Thanksgiving and Christmas-to-New-Year sailings are excluded.
checks.family_of_four: Two full-fare guests (for example, two parents) pay full fare; two kids 12 and under in the same stateroom pay USD 0 cruise fare under Kids Sail Free. Taxes, fees and port expenses are still charged for all four, so the kids are not free. The separate Free 3rd and 4th Guests offer works the same way for any 3rd and 4th guest, with no age limit stated in our record.
terms: Kids Sail Free: select 3+ night sailings departing on or after October 7, 2026. Free 3rd and 4th Guests: sailings October 7, 2026 to August 20, 2027.
Kids Sail Free: 12 and under on the departure date.
The child sails in the same stateroom as 2 full-fare guests.
Sailings November 19 to 27, 2026 and December 17, 2026 to January 4, 2027 are excluded, as are spring break 2027 dates and some Navigator sailings.
Taxes, fees and port expenses for every guest, including the free-fare kids.
unclear: Our record does not list the exact spring break 2027 dates that are excluded; they are on the terms page.
Our record does not list which sailings and stateroom categories qualify; check them at booking.
before_booking: Price the same sailing with and without the kids to see what the free fare is worth after taxes, fees and port expenses.
Check your sailing date against the holiday and spring break exclusions.
Confirm both children will be 12 or under on the departure date.

checks.title: Great Wolf Lodge Fall Flash Sale: up to 40% off suites
checks.headline: Up to 40% off the room rate for stays to February 11, 2027, priced for two guests; a family of 4 adds an extra-person fee for each extra guest, and activity passes (Wolf, Paw, Pup) are not included.
checks.family_of_four: The sale rate is per room, per night for two guests. Great Wolf adds a USD 20 additional-person fee for each extra guest, so two more family members add to the advertised rate. The discount applies to the room rate only: taxes, activity passes (Wolf, Paw, Pup) and incidentals are extra. One person in the room must be 21 or older (18 at Wisconsin Dells).

checks.title: Beaches First Passport Offer: USD 135 resort credit per young child
checks.headline: A USD 135 resort credit per child ages 5 and under with a newly issued passport, up to two children, on 5+ paid-night stays; book by October 31 and travel by November 6, 2026.
checks.family_of_four: A family with two children ages 5 and under at check-in, each with a recently issued passport, can receive up to USD 270 in resort credit on a stay of at least five paid nights. It is a credit for listed resort extras (spa, room upgrades, extended stays and similar), not a cut in the room price, and the travel window closes November 6, 2026.
terms: October 31, 2026, on Beaches websites or through a travel advisor.
Ages 5 and under at check-in; up to two children per booking.
USD 135 per eligible child (maximum USD 270 per booking), issued on arrival after the resort checks the passport.
A valid passport issued after August 1, 2025 (also the start of the booking window); the original must be shown at check-in. The page describes the offer as valid with U.S. or Canadian passports.
Register the booking on the offer page. Registering does not guarantee eligibility.
Spa services (15% service charge payable), room upgrades, extended stays, internet upgrades, private dinners, wet suit rentals, photo images, scuba, laundry (not dry cleaning) and cabana rental.
No cash value; not for contracted groups or industry rates; the offer can be withdrawn at any time.
unclear: The offer page does not list which Beaches resorts take part.
before_booking: Check that each child's passport was issued after August 1, 2025 and that both will be 5 or under at check-in.
Book at least 5 paid nights within the travel window (to November 6, 2026); confirm whether the whole stay must end by then.
Register the booking on the offer page after booking.

checks.title: Club Med all-inclusive offer: kids under 4 stay free, up to 40% off
checks.headline: Book by January 6, 2027 and travel by July 2, 2027 in the Caribbean, Canada or Mexico; only children under 4 are shown as free, and the conditions behind the asterisks were not readable on the offer page.
checks.family_of_four: Only children under 4 are shown as staying free. The other savings are per person per week and an air credit when flights are booked with Club Med; how they apply depends on footnoted conditions the page did not display.
